relationships.description: Ocrelizumab binds CD20 on B cells, depleting them via ADCC and CDC; first therapy approved for both RMS and PPMS
Ofatumumab is a fully human anti-CD20 antibody binding a distinct epitope for B cell depletion; self-administered subcutaneously
Ublituximab is a glycoengineered anti-CD20 antibody with enhanced ADCC for rapid B cell depletion
Rituximab depletes CD20+ B cells via ADCC, CDC, and apoptosis; widely used off-label for MS
Natalizumab blocks α4-integrin (VLA-4), preventing lymphocyte adhesion to VCAM-1 and migration across the blood-brain barrier
Fingolimod-phosphate causes S1PR1 internalization, sequestering lymphocytes in lymph nodes and preventing their entry into the CNS
Siponimod selectively modulates S1PR1/5; CNS-penetrant with potential pro-remyelination effects via S1P5 on oligodendrocytes
Ozanimod selectively modulates S1P1/5 with no S1P3 activity, avoiding first-dose bradycardia; CNS-penetrant
Ponesimod is a highly selective S1P1 modulator with rapid receptor kinetics allowing quick lymphocyte recovery upon discontinuation
Dimethyl fumarate activates NRF2 antioxidant pathway and agonizes HCAR2/GPR109A on immune cells for anti-inflammatory and cytoprotective effects
Diroximel fumarate is a prodrug of monomethyl fumarate activating NRF2 with improved GI tolerability over dimethyl fumarate
Teriflunomide inhibits DHODH, blocking de novo pyrimidine synthesis and selectively reducing activated lymphocyte proliferation
Cladribine is a purine analogue causing selective lymphocyte depletion; immune reconstitution therapy with durable treatment-free periods
Alemtuzumab depletes CD52+ lymphocytes, followed by homeostatic reconstitution with an altered, less autoreactive immune repertoire
Glatiramer acetate mimics myelin basic protein, competing for MHC class II binding and inducing a Th1→Th2 shift in myelin-reactive T cells
IFN-β binds IFNAR1/IFNAR2, activating JAK/TYK2-STAT pathway to reduce pro-inflammatory cytokines and restore BBB integrity
IFN-β engages IFNAR2 as part of the heterodimeric type I IFN receptor complex to activate intracellular signaling
Evobrutinib is a covalent BTK inhibitor targeting BCR signaling in B cells and FcR signaling in myeloid cells; CNS-penetrant
Tolebrutinib is a CNS-penetrant covalent BTK inhibitor targeting smoldering microglial and B cell inflammation in progressive MS
Mitoxantrone intercalates DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, causing broad immunosuppression; limited by cumulative cardiotoxicity
High-dose methylprednisolone activates GR for rapid anti-inflammatory effects; accelerates relapse recovery without altering disease course
HLA-DRB1*15:01 is the strongest MS genetic risk factor (OR 3.1); preferentially presents myelin peptides to autoreactive CD4+ T cells
rs6897932 SNP alters IL7R splicing (OR 1.2); increased soluble IL-7R enhances survival of autoreactive T cells
IL2RA rs2104286 impairs Treg function (OR 1.2); shared risk across MS, T1D, RA, and autoimmune thyroid disease
CD40 rs1883832 enhances B-T cell costimulation (OR 1.2); promotes meningeal B cell follicle formation in progressive MS
rs1335532 in CD58 (LFA-3) associated with MS (OR 1.3); CD58-CD2 interaction critical for T cell activation and CNS migration
rs1800693 SNP produces soluble TNFR1 variant (Δ6-TNFR1) associated with MS (OR 1.2); links TNF pathway to MS risk
IRF8 critical for microglial development; polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.2) and linked to CNS inflammation
CYP27B1 variants impair vitamin D activation (OR 1.2); vitamin D deficiency is established MS risk factor
STAT3 is master Th17 transcription factor; polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15); central to IL-23/Th17 axis
TYK2 mediates IL-12/23 and type I IFN signaling; protective variant P1104A reduces MS risk; both Th1/Th17 and IFN pathways implicated
CLEC16A regulates autophagy and thymic T cell selection; rs12708716 associated with MS (OR 1.15); shared across autoimmunity
EVI5 regulates cell cycle and may influence oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation; rs11809721 associated with MS (OR 1.15)
CD6-ALCAM mediates T cell migration across BBB; rs17824933 associated with MS (OR 1.2); CD6 blockade reduces EAE
CD86 (B7-2) costimulatory ligand; polymorphisms alter T cell activation thresholds; associated with MS (OR 1.15)
CBLB negatively regulates TCR signaling; polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15); CBLB-deficient mice develop spontaneous autoimmunity
RGS1 regulates B and T cell chemotaxis; rs1323292 associated with MS (OR 1.15); may promote immune cell CNS migration
CXCR5+ Tfh cells enriched in MS CSF and meninges; CXCL13 elevated in MS CSF; associated with intrathecal IgG production
LIGHT-HVEM promotes meningeal lymphoid neogenesis in progressive MS (OR 1.2); drives tertiary lymphoid structure formation
CD226 Gly307Ser variant alters CD226-TIGIT balance (OR 1.15); reduces inhibition of autoreactive CD8+ T cells in CNS
MAPK1 (ERK2) critical for oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelination (OR 1.15); dysregulated ERK may impair remyelination
TACI (BAFF/APRIL receptor) variants associated with MS; elevated BAFF in MS CSF drives autoreactive B cell survival
IL-22BP decoy receptor variant associated with MS (OR 1.15); IL-22 elevated in MS lesions, promotes astrocyte proliferation
CD20 is the therapeutic target for B cell depletion therapy in MS; expressed on B lineage cells from pre-B to mature/memory B cells
CD40-CD40L costimulation drives germinal center B cell responses and meningeal follicle formation in progressive MS
CXCR5 directs B and Tfh cells to CXCL13-rich meningeal follicles; key chemokine axis in CNS-compartmentalized inflammation
TACI (TNFRSF13B) is receptor for BAFF and APRIL; BAFF promotes survival of autoreactive B cells in MS CNS
IL-7 signaling through IL-7R promotes T cell survival including Th17 cells; altered IL7R splicing may enhance pathogenic Th17 persistence
STAT3 is the master transcription factor for Th17 differentiation downstream of IL-6, IL-21, and IL-23 receptors
TYK2 mediates IL-23 receptor signaling critical for Th17 maintenance and pathogenicity in CNS autoimmunity
IL-22BP (IL22RA2) is a soluble decoy receptor neutralizing IL-22 produced by Th17 cells; regulates IL-22-mediated CNS inflammation
TNFR1 signals through NF-κB, driving pro-inflammatory gene expression; soluble TNFR1 variant may dysregulate this pathway
TYK2 is a JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN signaling through IFNAR1/IFNAR2 → STAT1/STAT2
IRF8 regulates microglial development and is induced by type I and type II IFN signaling; key transcription factor in CNS myeloid cells
CD6 binds ALCAM (CD166) on BBB endothelium, complementing VLA-4/VCAM-1 in mediating T cell adhesion and migration into CNS
RGS1 regulates GPCR chemokine signaling driving immune cell chemotaxis and CNS infiltration; attenuates Gαi-coupled receptor signals
CD40 activation on endothelial cells upregulates adhesion molecules including VCAM-1, enhancing leukocyte BBB transmigration
Anti-CD20 B cell depletion therapy; first and only approved for both RMS and PPMS. Reduces ARR by 46% and disability progression by 24%
Self-administered monthly anti-CD20; superior to teriflunomide with 50-59% ARR reduction in ASCLEPIOS trials
Glycoengineered anti-CD20 with 1-hour infusion; 49-59% ARR reduction vs teriflunomide in ULTIMATE trials
Chimeric anti-CD20 widely used off-label; strong real-world evidence from Swedish MS Registry showing high effectiveness
Anti-VLA-4 integrin blocker; 68% ARR reduction in AFFIRM; most effective non-B-cell-depleting DMT. PML risk requires JCV monitoring
First oral DMT; S1P receptor modulator sequestering lymphocytes. 54% ARR reduction in FREEDOMS
Selective S1P1/5 modulator; first oral therapy effective for active SPMS. 21% reduction in confirmed disability progression
Selective S1P1/5 with no S1P3 activity; no first-dose bradycardia monitoring needed. 48% ARR reduction vs IFNβ-1a
Highly selective S1P1 modulator; 30.5% ARR reduction vs teriflunomide in OPTIMUM; rapid recovery upon discontinuation
NRF2 activator with anti-inflammatory and cytoprotective effects; 44-53% ARR reduction in DEFINE/CONFIRM trials
Next-generation fumarate with improved GI tolerability; bioequivalent to dimethyl fumarate with significantly fewer GI side effects
First-line oral DMT; DHODH inhibitor reducing lymphocyte proliferation. 31% ARR reduction in TEMSO
Immune reconstitution therapy; short oral courses over 2 years. 58% ARR reduction; durable treatment-free remission
Anti-CD52 immune reconstitution therapy; deep lymphocyte depletion. 55% ARR reduction. Restricted due to secondary autoimmunity risk
Synthetic MBP-mimicking polypeptide; Th2 shift in myelin-reactive T cells. Modest efficacy but excellent long-term safety
First DMT class for MS; reduces pro-inflammatory cytokines and restores BBB integrity. 18-36% ARR reduction
Investigational CNS-penetrant BTK inhibitor; Phase 2: 70-80% reduction in Gd+ lesions. Targets B cells + microglia
Investigational CNS-penetrant BTK inhibitor in Phase 3 for RMS and progressive MS; targets smoldering CNS inflammation
Last-line cytotoxic agent; 60-70% ARR reduction in active SPMS but limited by cumulative cardiotoxicity and leukemia risk
B cells drive MS through antigen presentation, cytokine production, and meningeal follicle formation sustaining CNS-compartmentalized inflammation
S1P gradient sensing drives lymphocyte egress from lymph nodes into circulation and ultimately CNS; this pathway is therapeutically targeted by 4 approved drugs
VLA-4/VCAM-1-mediated lymphocyte adhesion and transmigration across the BBB is a critical gatekeeper step in MS lesion formation
Th17 cells produce IL-17, GM-CSF, and IL-22, disrupting BBB tight junctions and promoting neuroinflammation; genetically linked by STAT3, TYK2, IL23R variants
Oxidative stress and NF-κB-driven inflammation drive neurodegeneration in progressive MS; NRF2 activation is therapeutically protective
Type I IFN signaling has a paradoxical protective role in MS (IFN-β is therapeutic) while pathogenic in SLE; TYK2 links both IFNs and IL-12/23
BTK signaling in B cells and microglia drives both peripheral immune activation and CNS-compartmentalized smoldering inflammation in progressive MS
Myelin Basic Protein (18q23): Prototype MS autoantigen. MBP-specific T cells in MS/EAE.
Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein (6p21.33): Anti-MOG defines MOGAD spectrum overlapping MS.
Interleukin-23 Receptor (1p31.3): IL23R R381Q protective variant (OR 0.6). Strong MS GWAS hit.
CD4 Molecule (12p13.31): CD4+ T cells are primary drivers of CNS inflammation in MS.
CD8a Molecule (2p11.2): CD8+ T cells dominate MS lesion infiltrates.
Janus Kinase 1 (1p31.3): JAK1 mediates multiple MS-relevant cytokine signals.
MBP is the prototype MS autoantigen; MBP-specific T cells drive CNS autoimmunity
Anti-MOG defines MOGAD spectrum overlapping MS; MOG is a key myelin autoantigen
IL23R R381Q protective variant reduces IL-23 signaling; strong MS GWAS hit
IL-23R is the receptor for IL-23; protective R381Q variant reduces Th17 pathogenicity
CD4+ T cells are primary drivers of CNS inflammation in MS; Th1/Th17 polarization
CD4+ T cells require integrin-mediated adhesion for BBB transmigration into CNS
CD8+ T cells dominate MS lesion infiltrates and require BBB transmigration
JAK1 mediates multiple MS-relevant cytokine signals through JAK-STAT pathways
JAK1 transduces signals for IL-6 and type I IFN in Th17 differentiation
Th17 cells produce IL-17, GM-CSF, and IL-22, disrupting BBB and promoting neuroinflammation in MS
VLA-4/VCAM-1-mediated lymphocyte adhesion and transmigration across the BBB is critical for MS lesion formation
Ocrelizumab depletes CD20+ B cells, reducing antigen presentation and CNS-compartmentalized inflammation
Natalizumab blocks α4-integrin (VLA-4), preventing lymphocyte BBB transmigration into CNS
Natalizumab directly blocks VLA-4/VCAM-1 interaction, preventing immune cell BBB crossing
Ofatumumab is a fully human anti-CD20 antibody depleting B cells in MS
IFN-β binds IFNAR1/IFNAR2, shifting cytokine balance from Th1/Th17 toward Th2/IL-10
Dimethyl fumarate activates NRF2 antioxidant pathway and suppresses NF-κB-driven inflammation
Fingolimod modulates S1P receptors, sequestering lymphocytes in lymph nodes
Evobrutinib is a CNS-penetrant BTK inhibitor targeting BCR and microglial signaling
Methylprednisolone broadly suppresses NF-κB-mediated CNS inflammation in acute relapses
Cladribine is an immune reconstitution therapy selectively depleting lymphocytes
Teriflunomide inhibits DHODH, reducing proliferation of activated pathogenic T and B cells
